definitions.meaning: An implement belonging to a plough

quotations.old_english: Gegaderie hé ealle his sulhgeteógo tógædere
quotations.english: let him collect together all the apparatus of his plough

source_text: sulh-geteóh; gen. -teóges; n. An implement belonging to a plough :-- Gegaderie hé ealle his sulhgeteógo tógædere let him collect together all the apparatus of his plough, Lchdm. i. 400, 19.
